messages:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we agreed to a list of remediation owners for the alert noise items. I'm starting this thread to track owners + SLAs.
matt: thanks. can we call out which alerts are causing the most pages? I have a partial list from pagerduty -> slack exports.
kevin: top 3 by count last 30d: redis-ttl-exhaustion, model-timeout-99, gpu-memory-spike. Together ~60% of pages.
cara: redis-ttl-exhaustion is mostly duplicate pages across regions. suggested fix: dedupe by grouping key+region within 5m window. owner: cara. ETA: 2026-04-08.
sara: noted. add an action: update the alert rule to add "group_by: [key, region]" and test in staging. owner: cara. due: 2026-04-08.
matt: model-timeout-99: we should raise threshold to 1200ms for async routes, keep 700ms for sync ones. owner: matt. due: 2026-04-05. risk: might hide early regressions, so add a secondary warning metric at 700ms with no paging.
julia: +1 on secondary warning. I can add the non-paging metric (alert severity=info) and a dashboard panel. owner: julia. due: 2026-04-04.
kevin: gpu-memory-spike is noisy because jobs overlap during nightly batch. Proposal: add suppression window 2h for scheduled batch job tags and route pages only if usage > 90% for >10min. owner: kevin. due: 2026-04-10.
sara: ops-bot, can you create a follow-up ticket for each of these with the owner and due date? Include runbook links and link back to the PM.
ops-bot: Created tickets: #INC-2742 (cara) redis dedupe; #INC-2743 (matt) model timeout thresholds; #INC-2744 (julia) non-paging warning metric; #INC-2745 (kevin) gpu suppression. Link: https://tickets.internal/INC-2742
cara: ETA note: I'll prototype the dedupe rule as a suppression rule in alerts.yaml then run it in staging. snippet I plan to push:
```
- alert: RedisTTLExhaustion
  group_by: [key, region]
  suppression_window: 5m
  severity: high
```
matt: for the threshold change I'll attach perf histograms to the ticket. need a second sign-off from infra perf. @kevin can you review?
kevin: will review today. if perf looks good, I can approve the change and we can schedule the rollout during a quiet window.
julia: I'll add the dashboard panel and wire the new info metric to the incident dashboard. Also will add an alerting rule that doesn't page but triggers an internal slack message to #eng-runtime.
sara: nice. last item: recurring pattern analysis — @matt and @kevin to take a 60m spike hunt to see if these correlate with deployments or customer jobs. please post findings in the ticket before the due dates.
matt: scheduled a 1h blameless hunt tomorrow 10:00am PT. will take notes.
kevin: confirming. I'll bring flamegraphs and deployment timelines.
sara: thanks everyone. i'll close this thread once ops-bot confirms ticket updates and reminders. pls update tickets as you hit milestones. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check on 2026-04-12 for unresolved tickets.
cara: started a staging PR for dedupe rule, link in INC-2742. testing now.
matt: updated INC-2743 with perf histograms.
julia: dashboard PR opened, refer INC-2744.
